name: Summit AZ - SEO Baseline and Audit 2026-07-11
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-07-11

# Summary
The first SEO baseline for the Arizona site, built from a Search Atlas agent site audit (crawled about Jul 10) and then live-verified over SSH and WP-CLI on Jul 11. At that time the site still used Yoast. Four versions of the same content: `Summit-SEO-Baseline-2026-07-11.md` and `.pdf`, plus the client-facing `Summit-SEO-Audit-2026-07-11.docx` and `.pdf`.

# Key findings
- The Search Atlas crawl was stale and badly overstated. Live scope: 155 pages plus 10 posts (165).
- Missing meta descriptions: audit said 168, live truth 8 (mostly utility and policy pages).
- H1s: audit said 9 missing; live truth 0 missing, 3 pages with extra H1s.
- Image alts: audit said 59+; live truth 20 in the media library, 0 in rendered blogs.
- LocalBusiness and Service schema: audit said missing; already present (Plumber, Service, PostalAddress, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
- Organic traffic almost entirely branded; "plumber tempe" sat at position 15.

# Fixes applied Jul 11 (SSH and WP-CLI)
- 13 page titles standardized to "[Service] in [City], AZ | Summit Plumbing Pros".
- 2 meta descriptions written (locations page, Mesa FAQ page).
- 3 H1 cleanups (/plumbing/, /water-softeners/, /slow-drains/) via the Elementor document save API, with server backups.
- 15 image alts added; 3 pages set to noindex (thank-you page and two ad-only tankless landing pages).
- Footguns logged: Yoast needed `wp post update` to rebuild the indexable; Elementor `Document::save()` silently no-ops under WP-CLI without an admin current user.

# Decisions and status
- Left as content work: 300 to 500 words of localized Tempe copy for "plumber tempe". Optional: basic metas on policy pages.
- Superseded by the Sep 3 relaunch and the move to Rank Math.
